pr_title: release-23.2: opt: disallow mutations on virtual tables
pr_body:
Backport 1/1 commits from #113166 on behalf of @DrewKimball.

/cc @cockroachdb/release

----

This patch adds a defensive check to verify that the target of an insert, delete, or update is not a virtual table. Note that virtual tables already disallow all access privileges apart from `SELECT`, but we've seen internal errors due to an (unknown) code path where that check is failing. This patch doesn't add tests because the privilege check is expected to fail before the virtual table check.

Fixes #111414
Fixes #111644

Release note: None

----

Release justification: fix for rare internal error

review_comments: "delete from view" seems like a bit of a misleading error message. any reason why we don't say "table" or "virtual table"?

This was based on the postgres message for similar cases:
```
postgres=# delete from pg_cursors;
ERROR:  cannot delete from view "pg_cursors"
DETAIL:  Views that do not select from a single table or view are not automatically updatable.
HINT:  To enable deleting from the view, provide an INSTEAD OF DELETE trigger or an unconditional ON DELETE DO INSTEAD rule.
```

It's worth mentioning that we don't expect to get to this point, since virtual tables shouldn't allow mutation access privileges anyway. This is a defensive check to prevent an internal error we saw in a sentry report, but don't know how to reproduce.
